WITH result_agg AS (
-- Gom nhóm kết quả phát hành theo từng đợt chào bán trước khi JOIN
SELECT 
securities_offering_id,
SUM(total_collected_am) AS total_collected_am
FROM securities_offering_result
WHERE NVL(delete_flg, 0) = 0
GROUP BY securities_offering_id
)
SELECT
c.INDUSTRY_NAME AS nganh_cap1_id,
TO_CHAR(so.official_letter_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS thang_cong_van,
SUM(so.total_expected_am) AS gia_tri_cap_phep,
SUM(NVL(sor.total_collected_am, 0)) AS gia_tri_huy_dong,
SUM(so.total_expected_am) - SUM(NVL(sor.total_collected_am, 0)) AS chua_thanh_cong
FROM securities_offering so
JOIN company_profiles cp ON cp.id = so.company_profile_id
LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = cp.category_l1_id
LEFT JOIN result_agg sor ON sor.securities_offering_id = so.id
WHERE NVL(so.delete_flg, 0) = 0
AND so.certificate_date BETWEEN to_date(:pdate1,'yyyymmdd') AND to_date(:pdate2,'yyyymmdd')
GROUP BY
c.INDUSTRY_NAME,
TO_CHAR(so.official_letter_date, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY thang_cong_van, nganh_cap1_id;

),
result_agg AS (
-- Tổng hợp kết quả phát hành theo đợt
SELECT 
securities_offering_id,
SUM(total_successful_qty) AS total_successful_qty,
SUM(total_collected_am) AS total_collected_am

cp.COMPANY_NAME_VN AS ten_doanh_nghiep,
cp.equity_ticker AS ma_chung_khoan,
lv.LOOKUP_VALUE_VN AS hinh_thuc_chao_ban,

t.audit_org AS to_chuc_kiem_toan,

t.credit_rating_org AS don_vi_xep_hang_tin_nhiem,

NVL(r.total_successful_qty, 0) AS sl_ck_thanh_cong,

NVL(r.total_collected_am, 0) AS gia_tri_thanh_cong,

JOIN COMPANY_PROFILES cp ON cp.ID = t.company_profile_id
LEFT JOIN plan_agg p ON p.securities_offering_id = t.ID
LEFT JOIN LOOKUP_VALUES lv ON p.offering_method_cd = lv.LOOKUP_CD 
AND lv.LOOKUP_GROUP = 'SO_OFFERING_METHOD'

WITH plan_agg AS (
-- Gom nhóm bảng PLAN để đảm bảo mỗi đợt chào bán chỉ trả về 1 dòng đại diện
SELECT 
securities_offering_id,
MIN(offering_method_cd) AS offering_method_cd
FROM SECURITIES_OFFERING_PLAN
WHERE NVL(delete_flg, 0) = 0
GROUP BY securities_offering_id
),
offering_unique AS (
-- JOIN bảng chính với bảng PLAN đã gom nhóm
SELECT 
t.id,
t.application_cd,
t.approval_status_cd,
p.offering_method_cd
FROM SECURITIES_OFFERING t
LEFT JOIN plan_agg p ON p.securities_offering_id = t.id
WHERE NVL(t.delete_flg, 0) = 0
AND t.certificate_date BETWEEN to_date(:pdate1,'yyyymmdd') AND to_date(:pdate2,'yyyymmdd')
)
SELECT
COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status_cd = 'PENDING_REVIEW' THEN 1 END) AS sl_dang_ky,
COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status_cd = 'PENDING_APPROVE' THEN 1 END) AS sl_dang_xu_ly,
COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status_cd = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) AS sl_chap_thuan,
COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status_cd = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 END) AS sl_tu_choi,
COUNT(DISTINCT application_cd) AS tong_ho_so,
-- Tính % Tỷ lệ
ROUND(
COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status_cd = 'PENDING_REVIEW' THEN 1 END)
/ NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT application_cd), 0) * 100, 2) AS ty_le_dang_ky_pct,
ROUND(
COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status_cd = 'PENDING_APPROVE' THEN 1 END)
/ NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT application_cd), 0) * 100, 2) AS ty_le_dang_xu_ly_pct,
ROUND(
COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status_cd = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END)
/ NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT application_cd), 0) * 100, 2) AS ty_le_chap_thuan_pct,
ROUND(
COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status_cd = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 END)
/ NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT application_cd), 0) * 100, 2) AS ty_le_tu_choi_pct
FROM offering_unique;

WITH plan_agg AS (
-- Lấy duy nhất 1 hình thức chào bán chính cho mỗi đợt chào bán để không nhân bản hồ sơ
SELECT 
securities_offering_id,
MIN(offering_method_cd) AS offering_method_cd
FROM SECURITIES_OFFERING_PLAN
WHERE NVL(delete_flg, 0) = 0
GROUP BY securities_offering_id
)
SELECT
lv.LOOKUP_VALUE_VN AS hinh_thuc_chao_ban,
EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.official_letter_date) AS nam,
round((COUNT(CASE WHEN t.approval_status_cd = 'PENDING_REVIEW' THEN 1 END)/COUNT(t.application_cd))*100,2) AS sl_dang_ky,
COUNT(CASE WHEN t.approval_status_cd = 'PENDING_APPROVE' THEN 1 END) AS sl_dang_xu_ly,
COUNT(CASE WHEN t.approval_status_cd = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) AS sl_cap_phep,
COUNT(CASE WHEN t.approval_status_cd = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 END) AS sl_tu_choi,
COUNT(t.application_cd) AS tong_ho_so
FROM SECURITIES_OFFERING t
LEFT JOIN plan_agg p ON p.securities_offering_id = t.ID
LEFT JOIN LOOKUP_VALUES lv ON p.offering_method_cd = lv.LOOKUP_CD 
AND lv.LOOKUP_GROUP = 'SO_OFFERING_METHOD'
WHERE NVL(t.delete_flg, 0) = 0
AND t.certificate_date BETWEEN to_date(:pdate1,'yyyymmdd') AND to_date(:pdate2,'yyyymmdd')
GROUP BY
lv.LOOKUP_VALUE_VN,
t.official_letter_date
ORDER BY
t.official_letter_date,

FROM SECURITIES_OFFERING_RESULT 
WHERE NVL(delete_flg, 0) = 0

SELECT

WHEN r.offering_method_cd = 5 
THEN cp.company_name_vn -- company_name_vn (sửa từ COMPANY_NM_VN trong CSV)
